newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Trade in Hai Hong shares suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trade in Hai Hong shares suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of industrial investment group China Merchants Hai Hong Holdings Co Ltd was suspended at the company's request pending an announcement, the Hong Kong stock exchange said on Tuesday.
China Merchants Hai Hong shares ended HK$0.50 higher at HK$6.55 on Monday on volume of 27.99 million shares.
Last week, the company said it would seek views from the Hong Kong stock exchange regarding its plan to buy assets from its 60-percent controlling parent.
China Merchants Hai Hong engages in the manufacture of paint products in China and Hong Kong, vessel owning and operations, and industrial investments.
